dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped annuli distributed across the mid-dorsal and lateral regions. These structures feature high-contrast, light-grey perimeter boundaries transitioning sharply from the dark exterior pelt to a lower-intensity, darker interior core.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low spatial density of solid high-intensity clusters. Sparse, small irregular flecks without internal gradients are visible primarily on the anterior neck region and lower lateral flank.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent mid-dorsal annuli form an obtuse triangle. A secondary arrangement of four smaller annuli follows the curvature of the upper dorsal line in a linear sequence.
